ops.body: Root cause of the EIO this task's recovery gap surrounds is now confirmed and filed separately: daemonkit-emitted helper plists carry LimitLoadToSessionType, which launchctl bootstrap deterministically refuses with exit 5 in at least two configurations (matrix in the new P1). The retry loop's misclassification this task describes is real and stands — a persistent exit 5 burns all 6 "in flux" retries — but with the key no longer emitted the helper-install trigger disappears. Keep this task for the classification/recovery gap itself: distinguishing deterministic bootstrap refusal from genuine in-flux, and surfacing it as a hard error instead of a timeout-shaped failure.
